title: chatlab scenario
description: One check of the agent, run by tools/chatlab (ADR-0048). The Go loader internal/chatlab.LoadScenario is the validator; this schema is for editors, docs and the agent.

why.description: The bug this scenario guards against.

covers.description: Files it depends on, relative to the repository; dir/** is a tree. It runs again when one changes.

repeat.description: How many times it runs; 3 by default, 5 for language.

persona.description: default, the example persona, or a directory under the scenario's.

skills.description: Directories under the scenario's, copied to workspace/skills.

model.description: scripted runs a fake model that plays script; for a mechanic a real model cannot be made to repeat.

script.description: The scripted model's answers, in order.

review.description: The scripted memory review's answers, in order, each a JSON object such as {"ops":[]}; after them it answers {"ops":[]}. Needs model: scripted.

modules.description: Modules the node has installed from the start: the lab's probe module under the manifest's name, rights and defaults (its config keys op_cron and op_tool_<tool> pick what a run does).

config.description: The settings the owner wrote for modules before the node starts, by short name: a mapping of config keys to values.

edge.description: Opens the node's entry for edges, so the steps start_edge, edge_link, edge_emit and the edge facts can run an edge beside it.

args.description: The tool's arguments, as JSON text. $BUILD stands for the digest the last module.build answered.

writes.description: A message that reaches the inbox before this answer returns, so that it is overtaken.

hold.description: How long the model works on this answer before it returns, a Go duration such as 1s: an adds step's second message then arrives during the turn.

forwarded.description: The owner forwards it: outside text.

other.description: Another listed person writes it in the owner's chat.

adds.description: A message and, after a pause, a second one while the first is being answered. For a real model.

name.description: The short name, as in local/<name>; the manifest's name too.

node.description: The edge the module's line in the node's file names: the node delivers the module there and does not run it.

url.description: http, at a host name: the fetcher trusts no test certificate.

press.description: A button's label. Not showing is a failure.

judge.description: A claim about the model's last words.

language.description: Checks the model's last words by their letters, with no model.

join_edge.description: An edge joins with the one-time code in the newest card that shows one, as the join command on the owner's computer would.

start_edge.description: The edge that joined runs beside the node, in the same process, as a leaf of the node's embedded server. Needs edge: true and a join_edge before.

edge_link.description: Cuts the edge's link (down) or restores it (up, and waits until it is linked again).

edge_emit.description: The edge makes this many events, as one of its modules would.

install_module.description: A new build of a module of the scenario is installed on the node, as the owner's install would: the manifest's version must be higher.

sign_in.description: The owner signs in from the newest sign-in card at the fake authorization server and pastes the line the intake page shows. Needs mcp with oauth.

mcp.description: A fake remote MCP server the node can connect at https://shop.example.com/mcp.

oauth.description: The server is an OAuth protected resource with a fake authorization server of its own.

reply.description: The person replies to the newest bot message whose text holds to. None showing is a failure.

reach.description: A state the scenario needs; without it the repeat is inconclusive.

nudge.description: Said once when the state is missing.

err_contains.description: The call failed with an error holding this text.

count.description: Exactly this many rows; at least one when unset.

facts.description: A closed list of checks; any failure in any repeat fails the scenario.

questions.description: Messages showing an Approve button now.

message_replaced.description: A message edited, with no buttons, holds this text.

question.description: The messages showing an Approve button now: the questions' text.

taken.description: Messages that joined a running turn so far.

replies.description: The model's messages since the last action.

tainted.description: The chat's session holds outside content.

model_calls.description: Calls the node has made to a model since it started.

absent.description: Paths under the node's folder (workspace/modules/x/target) that must not exist.

card.description: The messages showing buttons now: their text.

edge.description: The edge beside the node. The step waits, up to a minute, until all of it holds.

deleted.description: The person's messages the bot deleted so far.

model_saw.description: Everything a scripted model was sent so far. Needs model: scripted.

linked.description: The edge's link to the node is up.

held.description: Events the edge's own stream keeps.

core_held.description: Events of the edge that the node's stream holds.

running.description: The version of a module that runs on the edge.

actual.description: What the edge says it runs of a module (its actual key), as the node reads it.
